what: Round 2 of the reaction-flow reply study (react flow v1.6.1), written before the run. The same eight-extra merge request as round 1; two cases of round 1 (a wrong reply followed by the name in backticks with a full stop, and a dismissal with a capital and a full stop) are replaced by the two cases that were dropped from the first draft before round 1 ran: a question and 'keep it', both expected to leave the thread open. Expected outcomes: kept, dismissed, removed or open as in round 1.
limits: One run, one merge request, eight cases written by us, one author account, one model reading. It measures how the model reads our reply tests, not how people will answer.
